name: Citizenship by Birth to a Slovak Citizen Parent

qualifying_event.description: A child acquires Slovak citizenship at birth if at least one parent is a Slovak citizen. A child born in Slovakia to stateless or foreign parents who have not acquired another nationality also acquires Slovak citizenship, as does a child found in Slovakia whose parents remain unknown.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of at least one parent's Slovak citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent was a Slovak citizen at the time of birth.
Born in Slovakia to stateless or foreign parents who have not acquired another nationality for the child, or born in Slovakia with parents unknown.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic (Washington consular page) -- citizenship by birth: at least one Slovak citizen parent, or born in Slovakia to stateless/foreign parents without another acquired nationality, or found in Slovakia with parents unknown
